[SWS_CM_10296] Invoke Event receive handler
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00203, RS_SOMEIP_00004
⌈
In case a receive handler was registered using the
SetReceiveHandler()
method
(see [SWS_CM_00181]) of the respective
Event
class for the event determined ac-
cording to [SWS_CM_10293] this registered receive handler shall be invoked when
the corresponding subscribed Event is received.
⌋
